lines.text: Isaiah son of Amoz tells the mortally ill Hezekiah to put his house in order because he will die.
Hezekiah turns his face to the wall, prays to the LORD, and weeps bitterly.
The LORD promises to add twenty years to Hezekiah's life and to deliver the city from the king of Babylon.
As a sign, the LORD makes the sun's shadow on the stairway of Ahaz go back ten steps.
Isaiah had said to apply balm from Gilead to the boil so Hezekiah would recover.
